title: control-matrix
description: Structured control matrix produced by the control-matrix skill. The matrix maps obligations to controls to evidence to owners. Foundational primitive consumed by compliance-testing, vendor-diligence, exit-plan, exam-brief, model-card-builder (controls section), and other downstream skills. Stable contract: additive changes only between minor versions; breaking changes ship as a versioned migration.

matrix_id.description: Stable identifier for this matrix instance. Reused across revisions of the same matrix.

as_of_date.description: Date the matrix was last revised.

engagement_id.description: Foreign key into scope.schema.json when the matrix was built under a formal scope.

process_or_product.description: The process, product, or function the matrix covers (e.g., commercial real estate underwriting, vendor lifecycle for critical fraud-screening service, monthly board credit-risk pack, model lifecycle for tier-1 retail credit models).

business_unit.description: Business unit that owns the process. Generic labels are insufficient; name the unit.

jurisdiction.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction (US, US-state-by-state, EU, UK, multi).

lines_of_defense.description: Lines of defense the matrix serves. Risk and compliance both consume the matrix; first-line controls testing reads it; internal audit references it.

label.description: Named source (e.g., 'OCC Bulletin 2026-13', 'BCBS 239 Principle 3', 'firm Credit Risk Policy v4.2').

section_reference.description: Section, principle, or paragraph reference. Use [verify section] in references/source-anchors.md when the exact reference is not yet confirmed; do not invent section labels here.

source_posture.description: public-only: only public regulatory sources informed the matrix. firm-policy-overlay: firm policies and standards augment the public source set. mixed: both, with named seams.

obligations_in_scope.description: Obligation IDs (foreign keys into obligation.schema.json) the matrix covers. Empty array is acceptable only when source_posture is firm-policy-overlay and the firm policy is the obligation source; flag in coverage_gaps when public obligations exist but have not yet been extracted.

controls.description: The matrix rows. Each row conforms to control.schema.json.

obligation_id.description: Foreign key into obligation.schema.json for the unmapped obligation.

gap_description.description: What is missing: no control designed, control designed but no owner, control owned but no evidence pathway, control evidenced but never tested.

coverage_gaps.description: Obligations in scope with no mapped control or with a partial mapping. A clean-looking matrix with no gaps usually means the gaps were buried.

control_ids.description: The two or more control IDs that overlap, or the single control ID that covers no obligation.

redundancies.description: Controls mapped to no obligation, or duplicate coverage of the same obligation by multiple controls without a designed-for purpose (defense-in-depth is not redundancy).

confidence_label.description: Author's confidence in the matrix as a whole. Per-control effectiveness ratings stay on the control row; this label reflects the source posture, evidence depth, and obligation-extraction completeness behind the matrix.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the human reviewer at sign-off. Specific to this matrix; not generic ('is this fit for purpose').

human_review_required.description: Always true. The skill stops at draft; a named reviewer attests before the matrix is filed.

revisions.description: Append-only revision log. Every material refresh of the matrix lands a row.
